canonicalization.digest_domains: artifact_table_sha256 over document_evidence.ARTIFACT_COLUMNS; review_a_table_sha256 over document_evidence.REVIEW_RECORD_COLUMNS under REVIEW_A_TABLE_DOMAIN. Both are subsets of the exported columns; hash_table sorts rendered rows, so the digests are independent of export row order.
canonicalization.field_order: migration 0015 column order per relation, preserved as JSON object key order
canonicalization.format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, one logical row per line, newline-terminated
canonicalization.json: json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')) — no spaces, no ASCII escaping
canonicalization.row_order: the relation's declared UNIQUE business key: document_artifacts by (accession_plain, source_class); document_review_records by (accession_plain, reviewer_role); document_review_spans by the parent record's accession_plain then span_ordinal
canonicalization.values: exact persisted governed values; NULL renders as JSON null; INTEGER columns render as JSON numbers. No value is invented and no timestamp is generated for this export.

notes: This is an export of already-frozen, owner-accepted evidence. No judgment, category, abstention, asserted form, asserted date, span, span text, or review epoch was changed.
document_adjudicated_evidence is empty by design: Review B and Claude adjudication were never executed and are not authorized.
No absolute path, private evidence-root locator, scratch path, raw session identifier, or personal reviewer name appears in any exported value.
